ortak.cevrimdisi: No internet connection — changes cannot be saved.
ortak.saltOkunur: You have view-only access to this screen.

tasarim.aciklama: Drag and drop fields to arrange the form. Changes stay in the draft; users are unaffected until you publish.
tasarim.paletAciklama: Drag onto the canvas to add. Drag a field back here to remove it.
tasarim.satirKolonlariAciklama: Reorder with the arrows, set the width in pixels, switch off columns you do not use.
tasarim.birimPxAciklama: The grid grows with its content and scrolls sideways.
tasarim.birimYuzdeAciklama: Width is a share of the screen; above 100% total the grid scrolls horizontally.
tasarim.ekranSecAciklama: Choose the screen whose design you want to change.
tasarim.onayRoluAciklama: Used as the ERP approval role when a request is submitted. Published together with the design.
tasarim.alanSecin: Select a field on the canvas to see its settings.
tasarim.gizliAciklama: The field is not shown to users, but the default value below is still submitted. To drop it entirely, drag it back to the palette.
tasarim.saltOkunurKilitli: This value is generated by the program; it is always read-only.
tasarim.kaldirilamaz: This field is required for saving and cannot be removed.
tasarim.yayinlandi: Design published; users now see this layout.
tasarim.yayinOnayMesaj: This layout will apply to all users. The previous version is archived and can be restored.
tasarim.kolonSec: Select a column to change its settings.
tasarim.erpZorunlu: ERP marks this field as required; it cannot be turned off.

dogrulama.enAzBirSatir: At least one request line is required.
dogrulama.aciklamaUzun: Description may be at most 200 characters.
dogrulama.hakkindaUzun: About may be at most 3072 characters.
dogrulama.adresUzun: Delivery address may be at most 200 characters.

anasayfa.aciklama: Access your ERP operations from the left menu.
anasayfa.bosDurum: The Purchase Request module will be here soon.

sql.aciklama: Test and Live connection definitions for the ERP MSSQL server. Stored procedures run against the active environment.
sql.sifreNotu: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Re-enter it if you change the server, port or username.
sql.aktifOrtamAciklama: Applies to all users: ERP writes (stored procedure calls) go to the selected environment's database.
sql.testSecimAciklama: Writes go to the test database — safe to experiment.
sql.canliSecimAciklama: Writes go to the production ERP database.
sql.canliOnayMesaj: From now on ALL writes will go to the production ERP database. Are you sure you want to continue?

dogrulama.portGecersiz: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
dogrulama.sifreZorunlu: Password is required on first save.

mail.aciklama: SMTP server and sender details for mails sent by the application (alerts, notifications).
mail.sifreNotu: Password is saved. Leave blank to keep it. Re-enter it if you change the server, port, username or encryption.
mail.sifreGirilmedi: No password yet; mail cannot be sent while a username is set.
mail.yonlendirmeAciklama: If set, ALL mails sent by the application go only to this address, not to the real recipients. Use during testing.
mail.yonlendirmeAktif: Redirect is on: all mails go only to {{adres}}.
mail.testAciklama: Sends a test mail with the saved settings; unsaved changes are not used. SMTP acceptance does not guarantee delivery to the inbox.
mail.testGonderildi: Test mail handed to the SMTP server: {{alici}}

dogrulama.sunucuGecersiz: Enter only the host name (e.g. smtp.office365.com), without scheme, port or spaces.
dogrulama.portGecersiz: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

entegrator.aciklama: Test and Live account definitions of the e-Invoice integrator (İzibiz). Invoices are read from the active environment.
entegrator.sifreNotu: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Re-enter it if you change the username or the API address.
entegrator.sinamaKapsami: This test only verifies the username and password; permission to read invoices is checked separately when listing.
entegrator.ortamUyumsuz: Warning: ERP (SQL) and the integrator are in different environments. Reconciliation and alerts will use data from different environments; results may be misleading.
entegrator.aktifOrtamAciklama: Applies to all users: invoices are read from the integrator account of the selected environment. Chosen independently of the SQL environment.
entegrator.testSecimAciklama: Invoices are read from the integrator's test account.
entegrator.canliSecimAciklama: Invoices are read from the real integrator account.
entegrator.canliOnayMesaj: After this, invoices will be read from the real integrator account. Are you sure you want to continue?

dogrulama.sifreZorunlu: Password is required on first save.
dogrulama.vknGecersiz: Tax ID must be 10 digits (national ID 11) and contain only digits.
dogrulama.apiAdresiGecersiz: Address must be https://host (no path or query).
dogrulama.aralikGecersiz: Interval must be between 15 and 1440 minutes (İzibiz: at least 15).
dogrulama.sayfaGecersiz: Must be between 10 and 100 (İzibiz: at most 100).

entegrator.apiAdresiNotu: If left empty, the environment default is used: {{varsayilan}}. Re-enter the password if you change the address.
entegrator.senkronAyarlariNotu: İzibiz rules: automatic fetching at most every 15 minutes, at most 100 invoices per request. The active environment’s setting is used.

roller.aciklamaMetni: Roles group permissions; roles are assigned to users on the Users screen. System administrators already have every permission.
roller.silOnayMesaj: Role "{{ad}}" will be deleted; {{sayi}} user(s) will lose its permissions.

dogrulama.adCokUzun: Role name can be at most 64 characters.
dogrulama.aciklamaCokUzun: Description can be at most 255 characters.

kullanicilar.aciklama: ERP users are listed. Only users granted access here can sign in, with their ERP password; what they see comes from their roles. ERP system administrators can always sign in.
kullanicilar.erpBilgiNotu: Name and password come from the ERP; only access and roles change here.
kullanicilar.pasifYapilamazNotu: Your own account's and the backup admin's access cannot be removed.
kullanicilar.yoneticiNotu: As a system administrator (ERP flag) this user already has every permission.
kullanicilar.girisIzni: Can sign in to the app
kullanicilar.erpOkunamadi: Could not reach the ERP; only users defined in the app are listed. Defining new users requires the ERP connection.

alarm.aciklama: Mail alerts for e-Invoices. Rules are evaluated on the active integrator account; alerts of the test account go only to the redirect address on the Mail (SMTP) screen. Mails carry no invoice details, only counts and a link.

parametre.gun: Days to wait after arrival at İzibiz

senkron_arizasi.aciklama: Technical alert when fetching from İzibiz fails repeatedly or data is not updated for the given time; a "resolved" mail when it recovers.

gunluk_ozet.aciklama: Every day at the given time, counts and totals of incoming and outgoing invoices first seen the previous day.

erp_okumadi.aciklama: Once a day, newly found incoming invoices that the ERP has not read although they reached İzibiz more than the given days ago. No alert when data is stale.

dogrulama.aliciZorunlu: An active rule needs at least one recipient.
dogrulama.aliciGecersiz: One of the recipients is not a valid e-mail address.
dogrulama.aralik: Enter a whole number between {{en}} and {{cok}}.

bildirim.aciklamaMetni: Failed or deliberately skipped notifications are listed too, so the reason for a missing mail is visible here.

kodlar.OLAY_KAPANDI: The problem was resolved before sending.
kodlar.TEST_YONLENDIRME_YOK: Test account alert; not sent to real recipients because no redirect address is set on the Mail (SMTP) screen.
kodlar.YENI_OLAY_YOK: Evaluated; no new invoices to report.
kodlar.SMTP_HATASI: The SMTP server did not accept the mail; will retry.
kodlar.ACILIS_GONDERILMEDI: Not sent because the opening mail of this problem was never sent.

hata.AG_HATASI: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
hata.YETKISIZ: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
hata.ERISIM_ENGELLI: You are not authorized for this action.
hata.DOGRULAMA: There are errors in the submitted data.
hata.COK_FAZLA_ISTEK: Too many requests; please wait a moment.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_ERISILEMEDI: Could not reach the integrator. Check the network and try again.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_KIMLIK_HATALI: Integrator username or password is incorrect.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_YANIT_GECERSIZ: The integrator returned an unexpected response.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_AKTIF_YOK: No active integrator environment is selected.
hata.guncellendiOtomatik: A new version has been installed; it takes effect after a refresh.
hata.guncellendiElle: Refresh the page to switch to the new version.
hata.EFATURA_EXCEL_COK_BUYUK: The filter matches more invoices than the Excel limit. Narrow the date range.
hata.EFATURA_SENKRON_SURUYOR: A manual sync is already queued or running.
hata.EFATURA_SENKRON_KAPALI: e-Invoice sync is disabled on the server.
hata.BEKLENMEYEN_HATA: An unexpected error occurred during sync (see server log).
hata.YAZMA_HATASI: Invoices could not be written to the database.
hata.ERP_OKUNAMADI: Could not read the ERP; eMOR was not changed. Please try again shortly.
hata.ERP_CANLI_TANIMSIZ: No live ERP connection is defined. Define the Live environment under Settings → SQL Connections.
hata.ERP_OKUMA_YETKISI_YOK: The ERP database user is not allowed to read this data. Ask the database administrator for SELECT permission.
hata.ERP_OKUMA_HATASI: ERP could not be read. Please try again shortly.
hata.KAYIT_KULLANILIYOR: This record is used by deduction rows and cannot be deleted.
hata.ICE_AKTARIM_HATALI: There are invalid rows; nothing was saved. Fix the errors below and check again.
hata.KESINTI_EXCEL_COK_BUYUK: The selected filter has more rows than the Excel limit. Narrow the filter.

izin.efatura_gizle: Hide / restore e-invoices in the list

efatura.excelAciklama: Exports the table as shown: the records on this page and the visible columns. For more records choose "All" as page size (at most 1000 records per page).
efatura.erpOkunduNotu: Integrator flag used by the ERP integration. This screen only shows it and never changes it.
efatura.veriZamaniYok: No successful sync covering today yet.
efatura.senkronKapali: Scheduled sync is disabled on the server; the list is not updated automatically.
efatura.guncelDegil: Data may be stale: no successful sync covering today in the last hour. Recent invoices may be missing.
efatura.ardisikHata: Last {{sayi}} sync runs failed or were incomplete ({{neden}}, {{zaman}}).

dogrulama.sira: End date cannot be before start date.
dogrulama.cokGenis: The date range can be at most {{gun}} days.

senkron.aciklama: Incoming and outgoing invoices in the selected range are re-read from İzibiz (at most {{gun}} days). The job runs in the background; this screen shows its status.
senkron.sirada: Manual sync is queued or running ({{baslangic}} – {{bitis}}).

dogrulama.gelecek: End date cannot be in the future.
dogrulama.sira: End date cannot be before start date.
dogrulama.cokGenis: The range can be at most {{gun}} days.

efatura.durumAlinamadi: Sync status could not be loaded; it is unknown whether the list is current.

erpSenkron.aciklama: Checks now whether the invoices in this list exist in the ERP (incoming: TOHOM_FATURA and TOHOM_HARCAMA_BELGESI, outgoing: sent e-invoice list) and updates the eMOR column. Also runs automatically every 5 minutes.
erpSenkron.tamam: eMOR updated: {{islendi}} processed, {{elle_islendi}} entered manually, {{havuzda}} in pool, {{yok}} not in ERP ({{degisen}} changed).

aciklama.islendi: Accepted into accounting (TOHOM_FATURA / TOHOM_HARCAMA_BELGESI, by ETTN)
aciklama.elle_islendi: Entered into the ERP manually without e-invoice matching: no ETTN, found by invoice number and tax id
aciklama.havuzda: Received by the ERP (TOHOM_E_FATURA), not yet accounted

efatura.istisnaFarkli: Exemption code differs between the integrator and the ERP

gizleme.aciklama: Hide the invoice if it is not ours (e.g. issued to another of our companies with the same tax id and delivered to the wrong mailbox). It is not deleted; it stays at the integrator and can be restored.
gizleme.gizliAciklama: This invoice is hidden from the list. Restoring shows it again.
gizleme.gizlendi: Invoice hidden; it appears only when "Show hidden too" is on.

turler.aciklamaMetni: Types of deductions applied to subcontractors. Excel summaries are linked to these types.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Code can be at most 20 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Name can be at most 100 characters.
dogrulama.kdvAralik: VAT rate must be between 0 and 100.

turler.ekranAciklamasi: This type can only be entered and imported on the selected screen. If left empty it cannot be used on any screen.

projeler.aciklamaMetni: Projects used in deduction records. They can be created manually or imported from the live ERP.
projeler.erpProjesiUyarisi: This project was imported from ERP. Changes made here will be listed for update to the ERP value when fetched from ERP again.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Project code can be at most 50 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Project name can be at most 200 characters.

firmalar.aciklamaMetni: Subcontractor companies subject to deductions. They can be created manually or imported from the live ERP; ERP companies are matched by GUID or tax number.
firmalar.erpFirmasiUyarisi: This company was imported from ERP. Changes made here will be listed for update to the ERP value when fetched from ERP again.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Company code can be at most 50 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Company name can be at most 200 characters.
dogrulama.vknCokUzun: Tax number can be at most 20 characters.
dogrulama.vergiDairesiCokUzun: Tax office can be at most 100 characters.
dogrulama.epostaCokUzun: E-mail can be at most 255 characters.
dogrulama.gsmCokUzun: Mobile number can be at most 30 characters.

firmalar.kodTekrarAciklama: This code is used by more than one company. Excel rows match companies by code, so make the codes distinct.
firmalar.firmamizAciklama: Marks our own company (e.g. HAB); created manually as it is not in the ERP subcontractor list. Only one company can be marked.
firmalar.firmamizDegisecek: Our company is currently "{{kod}} — {{ad}}". Marking this company will remove that mark.

paraBirimleri.aciklamaMetni: Currencies of deduction rows. The Excel "PARA BİRİMİ" value matches by code.

dogrulama.kodCokUzun: Code can be at most 10 characters.
dogrulama.adCokUzun: Name can be at most 50 characters.

icmal.silOnayMesaj: The "{{ad}}" row dated {{tarih}} will be deleted.
icmal.hesapAciklamasi: Charged = Total − Cancelled, Remaining = Charged − Deducted.

iceAktarim.aciklama: Select the Excel file or copy rows from Excel and paste them (copying the header row is recommended). Columns are recognised by header names. Then press Check: if every row passes, Save is enabled; otherwise each invalid row is listed with its reason.

dosyaHatasi.dosya_okunamadi: The file could not be read. Select a valid Excel (.xlsx) file.
dosyaHatasi.baslik_bulunamadi: Header row not found. Column headers (Kesinti Türü, Taşeron Adı, Proje…) must be within the first 20 rows.
dosyaHatasi.satir_yok: There are no rows below the header row.

iceAktarim.hataliDosya: {{sayi}} rows failed the check; nothing is saved until they are fixed. A summary by reason is below, and each row’s error is in the Error column of the table.
iceAktarim.hatasiz: {{sayi}} rows passed the check and are ready to save.

hataKodu.birden_fazla: This code belongs to more than one company; make the codes distinct on the Companies screen
hataKodu.baska_ekranin_turu: Not linked to this screen (Deduction Types → Screen)

yuklemeler.aciklama: Excel imports. A wrong upload can be undone together with its rows; manually entered rows are not affected.
yuklemeler.geriAlOnayMesaj: The upload from {{zaman}} and its {{sayi}} rows will be deleted.

tumu.aciklamaMetni: Records from every deduction screen in a single list with their common columns. No data is entered here; records are entered and corrected on their own deduction screen.

isgucu.aciklamaMetni: Labour deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

kamp.aciklamaMetni: Camp (room) deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

kampMalzeme.aciklamaMetni: Camp material deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

makinaEkipman.aciklamaMetni: Machinery and equipment deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

tutanak.aciklamaMetni: Report (tutanak) deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

yemek.aciklamaMetni: Meal deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

osgb.aciklamaMetni: OSGB Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

tetkik.aciklamaMetni: Health Check Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

isgCeza.aciklamaMetni: OHS Penalty Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

malzeme.aciklamaMetni: Material Deductions charged to subcontractors. Rows can be entered manually or imported from Excel; each import is kept as an upload and can be undone.

erpAktarim.ozet: {{yeni}} new, {{guncellenecek}} to update, {{eslesecek}} to link with a manual record, {{aktarilamaz}} cannot be imported. {{ayni}} records are already up to date.
erpAktarim.hepsiGuncel: All ERP records are already up to date; nothing to import.

neden.guid_gecersiz: The GUID in ERP is invalid.
neden.guid_tekrar: The same GUID appears in more than one ERP row.
neden.kod_tekrar: The same code is used by more than one ERP record.
neden.kod_baska_kayitta: This code is used by another record in the application.

yapistirma.ipucu: Select and copy rows in Excel, click the table and paste with Ctrl+V. If you copy the header row, columns are matched by name (Excel order does not matter); without it, rows are placed starting at the selected cell. Click a cell to correct it: Enter moves down, Tab moves right.
